title: Decision
description:
One closed edit-accept cycle: digests and numbers, no text. Key
`run:<label>:cycle:<k>`. Only [`cycle`] builds one.

```
fn f(d: &weksa::run::Decision) -> u32 { d.k() }
```

Every field is given, so the literal below fails only on privacy; its twin is
the same literal in the unit test `a_decision_literal_compiles_in_the_lib`.

```compile_fail,E0451
use weksa::run::{Call, Decision, Verdict};
fn f() -> Decision {
    Decision {
        k: 1,
        base_round: 1,
        base_rev: 1,
        base_inventory_digest: String::new(),
        edit: Call { prompt: String::new(), items: vec![] },
        edit_answer_digest: None,
        candidate_rev: None,
        candidate_inventory_digest: None,
        candidate_round: None,
        panel: vec![],
        verdict: Verdict::Accepted,
    }
}
```

base_round.description: The head's establishing round: the base of this cycle.

edit.description: The edit prompt's digest and the Train keys it held.

edit_answer_digest.description: 16 hex of the editor's answer; `None` when it was unreadable.

panel.description: One row per panel language, in panel order.

Call.description: One model call: the prompt's digest and the item keys it held.

oneOf.description: The composite fell, or a reading was not a finite number.

PanelReading.description:
One panel language's row of a cycle: the head's Validation reading, the
candidate's (none when the edit never reached a round), the language's
measured floor and the threshold derived from it. The threshold decides only
in a one-language panel ([`decide`]); with two or more languages it is
recorded beside the floor and the accept is the sum rule of
[`decide_panel`].

Reading.description: One validation reading: chrF 0 to 100, meaning 0 to 1, and their composite.

oneOf.description: The answer was not an edit draft.
The draft asked for no change or too many, or the inventory door refused it.
